$comment: Surface allowlist for mc:audit-surface. Two layers: 'infrastructure' (no user-visible promise — never need a tag) and 'backfillBacklog' (existing user-facing surfaces still awaiting a tag — grandfathered until backfilled). New files default to neither and must carry at least one of `// @promise promise:<slug>` / `// @aspect aspect:<slug>` / `// @check intent-check:<slug>` / `// @check acceptance-check:<slug>` within the first 24 lines. Multi-promise surfaces may declare multiple tags.
